description: Defines the 'integer' field type class 'IntegerItem' for Drupal, including storage settings, field settings, property definitions, constraints, schema, and sample value generation.

classes.name: IntegerItem
classes.description: Defines the 'integer' field type for Drupal, extending NumericItemBase, with methods for storage settings, field settings, property definitions, constraints, schema, and sample data generation.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings for the integer field, including 'unsigned' and 'size'.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings such as 'min', 'max', 'prefix', and 'suffix'.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the 'value' property as an integer data type with label 'Integer value'.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints, adding a range constraint if 'unsigned' is set.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the field, including 'unsigned' and 'size' options.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample integer value within 'min' and 'max' settings.
